translations.web: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. He made one hundred basins of gold.
translations.bsb: Additionally, he made ten tables and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north. He also made a hundred gold bowls.
translations.kjv: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.
translations.asv: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made a hundred basins of gold.
